component.name: SbarHive
صبار هايف
component.summary: Convert files locally from your file manager
حوّل الملفات محلياً من مدير الملفات

description.p: SbarHive converts and processes files entirely on your computer. Select files in your file manager, choose SbarHive from the context menu, and a honeycomb of actions that fit the selected files appears. The result is saved as a new file next to the original.
يحوّل صبار هايف الملفات ويعالجها على جهازك بالكامل. حدد الملفات في مدير الملفات واختر صبار هايف من قائمة النقر اليمين، فتظهر خلية نحل بالإجراءات المناسبة لها، ويُحفظ الناتج ملفاً جديداً بجانب الأصل.
No file ever leaves your computer.
Drag a file, hold a key, and drop it on the hive. The hive opens over every window at the pointer on Hyprland and KDE, and as a centred window on GNOME.
SbarHive appears in app launchers and opens its settings.
Video, audio, documents and PDF through FFmpeg, LibreOffice and Ghostscript, a settings window, and focus that works under strict focus policies in GNOME and KDE.
First release: the hive, image conversion, the background service and command line, and file manager integrations.
